claim: Weight-baking installs USABLE memory (recall+count+membership) into a portable stock-llama.cpp Q8 GGUF, generalizing across held-out phrasings and held-out fields, far above the plain base.
testbed: 71 Python ast node types (introspected ground truth), 53 trained / 18 control
eval: 355 held-out probes via mainline llama-server, GPU, temp 0
key_findings: runtime --lora does NOT preserve baked memory (0/15); merge->GGUF does.
signature-recall-only bake = string echo (E1045); use-shaped + scale + diversity = generalizing recall (E1047).
derived ops (count) require training that behavior (E1048); membership requires EXACT 1:1 balance (E1050) AND list-first answer ordering (E1051) so the verdict conditions on recited facts.
verdict-FIRST decouples the answer from the model's own correct recitation; list-FIRST fixes it.
next: apply recipe to non-AST facts (stdlib symbol->doc, squad) to prove generality
formal compiled benchmark vs plain base
